verdict.rationale: Firecrawl documents its own webhooks that notify an HTTPS endpoint when crawl, batch scrape, extract, agent or monitor-check jobs start, progress or finish, signed with HMAC-SHA256. That covers job-status monitoring and a callback path that could carry alerts. Explicit failure alerts, performance metrics and data-quality validation are not documented; schema-based extraction shapes the output but does not validate it. Missing for 10: explicit failure/error alerting, job performance metrics or dashboards, data-quality validation checks, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can monitor job performance, validate data quality, and receive alerts when something fails

citations.quote: Get notified the moment a crawl, batch scrape, extract, agent job, or monitor check starts, progresses, or finishes. Instead of polling for status, you provide an HTTPS endpoint
Verify that every webhook request actually came from Firecrawl by checking its HMAC-SHA256 signature.
